# portvmind_vke_cluster (Data Source)

Reads metadata for an existing VKE cluster (GET /cluster/:id).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "portvmind_vke_cluster" "example" {
  cluster_id = "<cluster_uuid>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster UUID.

### Read-Only

- `api_access` (String) Cluster API endpoint address.
- `id` (String) Cluster UUID (Terraform resource id).
- `kubernetes_version` (String) Kubernetes version of the cluster.
- `name` (String) Cluster name.
- `project_id` (String) PortvMind Cloud project ID that owns the cluster.
- `shared_security_group` (String) Shared security group associated with the cluster.
- `status` (String) Cluster status (for example, Active).
